about: A pop-up when the app opens: a flyer, a title, a line and a button to a screen, shown between from and until (New York dates), by id. show: daily (once a day, the default), once (one time on this phone), always (every launch). image: flyer:<file in civic/cal/flyers>, icon:<name in civic/icons> or pack:<path>. dest: a screen key as in tools.json (screen:org:<slug>, screen:calendar, screen:web:<site path>); leave it out and the pop-up just closes. Remove the splash object, or let the dates pass, and nothing shows. Builds from 128.

splash.title: Red Hook Recreation Center Update
splash.text: Tonight at 6 PM, 155 Bay Street. NYC Parks update on the reconstruction of Red Hook Recreation Center. RSVP to bkspecialevents@parks.nyc.gov.
